integrity: Analytic blocking and covariance-law proof; independent numerical illustrations do not prove a functional limit.
scientific_limitations: Requires bounded observations, finite-range independence and uniform-norm continuity of almost-periodic covariance lags; quenched weak convergence holds for almost every independent nonarithmetic renewal sampling schedule, with no claimed rate or independence certification.
title: A quenched functional limit theorem for renewal-sampled almost-periodic covariances
